as_told.title: NewsNation slide: DOE advanced gravity propulsion research, Havana syndrome victim

plain: A slide shown on NewsNation, a US news channel that Michels says covers UFOs a lot, is said to show a patient hurt in Department of Energy work on advanced gravity propulsion, with damage to the brain's white matter. Michels brings up the slide himself, once in a talk that touches on the journalist Ross Coulthart and the researcher Eric Weinstein, and once naming the slide "advanced gravity propulsion research" and tying the man's injuries to Havana syndrome, which he describes as some sort of biological effects. If true, it would suggest the government has been running exotic propulsion experiments that harm the people near them.
